title: Darkhound
wikitext:
[[image:Darkhound.png|right]]
A species of demonic dog.  Found in [[Tirisfal Glades]], the [[Eastern Plaguelands]], and [[Blackrock Depths]].  The dwarves of Blackrock Depths use a variety of '''Darkhound''' called a [[Bloodhound]] that easily sniffs out intruders hiding in stealth.

Darkhounds often drop wolf meat when killed.

Types of '''darkhounds''':
* Darkhounds ([[Tirisfal Glades]])
* Plaguehounds ([[Eastern Plaguelands]])
* Blighthounds ([[Eastern Plaguelands]])
* Bloodhounds ([[Blackrock Depths]])
